other_conditions: Applicant must be a native of Chhattisgarh
Applicant must be a senior citizen (age 60 or older), widow, or abandoned woman (age 18 or older)
Applicant must not be receiving pension benefits from any other central or state government pension scheme
In urban areas, the applicant's name must be listed in the Socio-Economic and Caste Census 2011
In rural areas, the applicant's name must be in the list of households having at least one deprivation index in the Socio-Economic and Caste Census 2011
benefits_summary: Eligible beneficiaries receive a pension of ₹500 per month, transferred directly to their bank account.
